rows.label: CHIMP
rows.clue: Intelligent somewhat arboreal ape of equatorial African forests

rows.label: DIRECT TRUST
rows.clue: A trust created by the free and deliberate act of the parties involved (usually on the basis of written documentation)

rows.label: PLACE NAME
rows.clue: The name by which a geographical place is known

rows.label: DISPERSION
rows.clue: Spreading widely or driving off

rows.label: GRATING
rows.clue: A barrier that has parallel or crossed bars blocking a passage but admitting air

rows.label: CANDY BAR
rows.clue: A candy shaped as a bar

rows.label: SPECIAL JURY
rows.clue: A jury whose members are selected for special knowledge for a case involving complicated issues

rows.label: TONAL PATTERN
rows.clue: The perception of pleasant arrangements of musical notes

rows.label: FORMULATION
rows.clue: A substance prepared according to a formula

rows.label: THETA WAVE
rows.clue: The normal brainwave in the encephalogram of a person who is awake but relaxed and drowsy

rows.label: MULTIPLE STAR
rows.clue: A system of three or more stars associated by gravity

rows.label: SHILLING
rows.clue: The basic unit of money in Uganda

rows.label: BORDERLAND
rows.clue: District consisting of the area on either side of a border or boundary of a country or an area

rows.label: BRACT
rows.clue: A modified leaf or leaflike part just below and protecting an inflorescence

rows.label: BRUNT
rows.clue: Main force of a blow etc

rows.label: CAMBER
rows.clue: A slight convexity (as of the surface of a road)

rows.label: WAIT
rows.clue: Time during which some action is awaited

rows.label: NONPROFIT
rows.clue: An organization chartered for other than profit-making activities

rows.label: DAMSELFLY
rows.clue: Slender non-stinging insect similar to but smaller than the dragonfly but having wings folded when at rest

rows.label: MEAL TICKET
rows.clue: A source of income or livelihood

rows.label: AVOWAL
rows.clue: A statement asserting the existence or the truth of something

rows.label: SINE WAVE
rows.clue: A wave whose waveform resembles a sine curve

rows.label: METRONOME
rows.clue: Clicking pendulum indicates the exact tempo of a piece of music

rows.label: CHEESE SAUCE
rows.clue: White sauce with grated cheese

rows.label: MAN AND WIFE
rows.clue: Two people who are married to each other

rows.label: GERM
rows.clue: Anything that provides inspiration for later work

rows.label: COLLOID
rows.clue: A mixture with properties between those of a solution and fine suspension

rows.label: SHEAR
rows.clue: (physics) a deformation of an object in which parallel planes remain parallel but are shifted in a direction parallel to themselves

rows.label: TILLED LAND
rows.clue: Arable land that is worked by plowing and sowing and raising crops

rows.label: TUBFUL
rows.clue: The amount that a tub will hold

rows.label: SKYLINE
rows.clue: The outline of objects seen against the sky

rows.label: FALSE HEATHER
rows.clue: North American decumbent evergreen heathlike plant with yellow flowers

rows.label: ACCORDINGLY
rows.clue: (sentence connectors) because of the reason given

rows.label: HEXAGON
rows.clue: A six-sided polygon

rows.label: SEEK TIME
rows.clue: (computer science) the time it takes for a read/write head to move to a specific data track

rows.label: CASHIER
rows.clue: Discard or do away with

rows.label: TAIL FEATHER
rows.clue: Feather growing from the tail (uropygium) of a bird

rows.label: HOLE CARD
rows.clue: Any assets that are concealed until they can be used advantageously

rows.label: TECHNOBABBLE
rows.clue: Technical jargon from computing and other high-tech subjects

rows.label: SPIKE
rows.clue: A transient variation in voltage or current

rows.label: VIOL
rows.clue: Any of a family of bowed stringed instruments that preceded the violin family

rows.label: POTTAGE
rows.clue: A stew of vegetables and (sometimes) meat

rows.label: ROW
rows.clue: An arrangement of objects or people side by side in a line

rows.label: KNOWLEDGE BASE
rows.clue: The content of a particular field of knowledge

rows.label: RHINESTONE
rows.clue: An imitation diamond made from rock crystal or glass or paste

rows.label: WHITEOUT
rows.clue: An arctic atmospheric condition with clouds over snow produce a uniform whiteness and objects are difficult to see

rows.label: CUMULUS
rows.clue: A globular cloud

rows.label: AMP
rows.clue: The basic unit of electric current adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites

rows.label: WHEREABOUTS
rows.clue: The general location where something is

rows.label: ORRIS
rows.clue: German iris having large white flowers with lavender-tinged falls and a fragrant rhizome

rows.label: COURTLINESS
rows.clue: Elegance suggestive of a royal court

rows.label: TAPER
rows.clue: A convex shape that narrows toward a point

rows.label: EMBOLISM
rows.clue: An insertion into a calendar

rows.label: DRY WALLING
rows.clue: The activity of building stone walls without mortar

rows.label: FLYING ROBIN
rows.clue: Tropical fish with huge fanlike pectoral fins for underwater gliding

rows.label: UPSET PRICE
rows.clue: (auction) the minimum price at which a seller of property will entertain bids

rows.label: CRASH COURSE
rows.clue: A rapid and intense course of training or research (usually undertaken in an emergency)

rows.label: STRENGTHENING
rows.clue: Becoming stronger

rows.label: POOL
rows.clue: An excavation that is (usually) filled with water

rows.label: RATATOUILLE
rows.clue: A vegetable stew

rows.label: PEASANTRY
rows.clue: The class of peasants

rows.label: PSEUDOSCIENCE
rows.clue: An activity resembling science but based on fallacious assumptions

rows.label: AUXIN
rows.clue: A plant hormone that promotes root formation and bud growth

rows.label: JET STREAM
rows.clue: A high-speed high-altitude airstream blowing from west to east near the top of the troposphere
